summary: End-to-end verified the Instructor Event Search feature. Backend: 14/14 pytest cases pass covering /api/events/search (filters, near-me, include_classes), /api/events/types auth gating, full CRUD lifecycle with role checks (regular user cannot create, non-owner instructor cannot edit, admin can edit any, owner can update+delete), and Nominatim geocoding both for real (lat/lng populated) and garbled (event saves with null lat/lng) addresses. Frontend: home-events-cta navigates to /events; /events page renders search input, GPS + city location chips, filters bottom sheet with all requested testIDs (type/level/date/include-classes/close/reset/apply); events-create (+) button visible only for instructors and opens /events/new; form validation blocks empty save; filling required fields and saving creates an event and redirects to /events/{id}; detail page shows share/edit/delete/open-maps testIDs for the owner; event-edit routes to /events/{id}/edit with pre-filled form; PATCH via event-form-save works. Login-gate on /events was verified from code (also functionally implied — the search endpoint requires auth). App boot regression: Home tab still loads streak, achievements CTA, feed preview, classes CTA, leaderboard, and Fresh-on-the-Floor sections without crash after the expo-location plugin was added.

issues: Console emits 'Unexpected text node: A text node cannot be a child of a <View>' repeatedly on the /auth screen. Likely a stray whitespace/newline between sibling JSX elements inside a View. Pre-existing (not caused by the events feature) but worth cleaning up.

react_native_issues.issue: React Native Web logs deprecation warnings: 'shadow* style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow.' and 'textShadow* style props are deprecated. Use textShadow.' Multiple pre-existing occurrences, e.g. /app/frontend/src/components/PracticeModePanel.tsx lines 997-1000, 1149-1152, 1266+. Not blocking, but should migrate to the RN 0.76+ boxShadow / textShadow APIs to future-proof.

action_items: Optional: track down the whitespace text-node warning on the /auth screen (search for stray '{" "}' or newlines between sibling elements inside a <View>).
Optional: migrate shadow*/textShadow* StyleSheet props to the new boxShadow/textShadow syntax across the codebase to silence RN Web deprecation warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: events.py backend: create_event / update_event correctly serialize + strip Mongo _id via _to_out and expose convenience lat/lng fields.
geocoding.py caches misses via not_found flag — good touch, avoids repeated Nominatim calls.
events/index.tsx: debounced (250ms) re-search on every filter change is reasonable; useFocusEffect also re-runs on tab focus — no duplicate fetch bug observed.
